summary: A visitor found this Thunder Bay District tower standing in August 2025 with its bottom ladder section detached; the visitor was unsure of its history.

facts.status_note: Bottom ladder section detached, per an August 2025 visitor report; treat the ladder as unsafe.

events.note: Visitor report, August 2025: tower still standing, bottom ladder section detached. Not an official inspection.

notes_for_editor: Thin evidence: one Firelookout.ca entry (a single visitor's note from August 2025, with no build year, design, height or staffing) and a gazetteer record for the lake. The brief has no local_unit; Thunder Bay District comes from the Mapcarta record for the lake, not from a source about the tower site. The brief's coordinates were not checked against the tower's exact site. The ladder warning rests on one visitor, not an inspection. The fan site is cited only for general Ontario context and does not mention Max Lake. Access is left unset: the Firelookout.ca entry gives no ownership or public-access status.
